newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: INSIGHT-Australia bonds look to keep rally intact.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Australia bonds look to keep rally intact.

text.p: *Australian bond futures held steady during after hours trading with the contract finishing just above 92.250 and keeping Tuesday's 92.300 peak in sight.
*Traders keeping a wary eye on RBA at 9.30 a.m. (2330 GMT).
Australian bond futures held steady during after-hours trading with the contract finishing just above 92.250 and keeping Tuesday's 92.300 peak in sight.
The contract ended SYCOM at 92.255 after ending Tuesday's pit session at 92.265 after easing to 92.220 at one stage.

The finish above 92.250 could allow for another run-up to 92.300, its highest level since late February, and where a break could see the advance continue from 92.010 which was seen at the beginning of the month.
On the downside analysts see support at 92.200 and 92.100.
The market will be keeping a wary eye on the Reserve Bank market operations at 9.30 a.m. (2330 GMT) when policy changes are usually announced following Tuesday's monthly RBA board policy meeting.

However, economists do not expect any change in the current 6.0 percent official interest rate following last week's stronger-than-expected wages data, and despite unemployment remaining high and a benign inflation outlook.
U.S. Treasuries ended marginally softer following a US$17.0 billion three-year note auction which received what was described as a "soggy" response.
